title: Blueprint `sk-thm-purity-transport`, étale case: **normalization of purity in relative dimension zero**: for an open immersion `j`, the purity isomorp
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $k$ be a field of positive characteristic $p\ne\ell$, and let $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$ be an open immersion between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with its canonical smooth structure of pure relative dimension zero [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $B_T=p_T^*\underline\Omega$ for the finite-extension-valued condensed algebraic closure $\underline\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and write $\mathcal C_T=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(T,\underline\Omega)$, $\mathbf1_T$ for its tensor unit, and $\iota_T:\mathcal C_T\hookrightarrow D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_T})$ for its full inclusion [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit]. Let $F=Rj_!$, $G=Rj^!$ and $\epsilon:FG\to\mathrm{id}$ be the specified bounded constructible compact-support adjunction [sk-def-sfb-dc-lower-shriek, sk-def-sfb-dc-upper-shriek]. Let $\operatorname{Tr}_j:F(B_X(0)[0])\to\mathbf1_Y$ be the actual finite-diagonal/deformation-normalized reconstructed trace [def-route-smooth-trace]; let $\alpha_j$ be its adjoint and $\operatorname{pur}_j=(\iota_X\alpha_j)^{-1}$, the isomorphism named $\mathrm{smoothPurityIso}\,\ell\,j\,0$. The complex $B_X(0)$ and the map $z_X:B_X(0)\xrightarrow{\sim}B_X$ are the zero Tate twist placed in degree zero and its canonical unit identification [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists], named $\mathrm{tateTwistDerivedZeroIso}$.

Let $j_{!,B}\dashv j_B^*$ be the restricted open adjunction on these bounded constructible categories [sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors, def-sfb-dc-open-lower-shriek-adjunction]. Let $\kappa:F\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{!,B}$ be the compactification comparison: $F$ is formed with the chosen compactification $c_j$ of $j$, and $\kappa$ is the independence isomorphism $Rj_!^{c_j}\cong Rj_!^{(j,\mathrm{id}_Y)}$ through a common refinement of $c_j$ and the trivial compactification $(j,\mathrm{id}_Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] by proper $Y$-morphisms whose squares with the open immersions are cartesian (along each such refinement: the proper/open exchange isomorphism, $R\mathrm{id}_*\cong\mathrm{id}$ and the direct-image composition isomorphism), followed by $R\mathrm{id}_{Y,*}\circ j_{!,B}\cong j_{!,B}$. Define $\beta_j:G\mathbf1_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_X$ to be the counit-compatible comparison $G\simeq j_B^*$ conjugate to $\kappa$, evaluated at $\mathbf1_Y$ and followed by the monoidal pullback unit identification $j_B^*\mathbf1_Y\simeq\mathbf1_X$ [lem-sfb-derived-pullback-strong-monoidal]. This is exactly $\mathrm{boundedConstructibleUpperShriekUnitIso\_padicAlgCl}\,\ell\,j$. Let $s_X:B_X(0)[0]\xrightarrow{\sim}B_X(0)$ be the canonical zero-shift isomorphism (in the upstream expression the shift is written $2\cdot((0:\mathbf N):\mathbf Z)$). Then the following equality of isomorphisms holds in the ambient derived category:
$$\operatorname{pur}_j=s_X^{-1}\circ z_X^{-1}\circ\iota_X(\beta_j):\quad\iota_XG\mathbf1_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}B_X(0)[0].$$
Equivalently, $\operatorname{Tr}_j$ is the open-adjunction counit transported through these specified zero-twist, zero-shift and compactification comparisons.

proof.text: Instantiate the existing unique representing-trace theorem for the open immersion at relative dimension zero. The canonical inverse of the upper-shriek unit isomorphism, composed with the zero-twist and zero-shift comparison, is an isomorphism from the Tate object to the exceptional image of the target unit. The generic adjunction Hom equivalence and this isomorphism give the required representing bijections for its counit composite.

Uniqueness in the representing-trace theorem identifies the chosen smoothTrace with that explicit counit composite. Apply the already proved reconstructed-trace inverse formula with the canonical zero-twist comparison and the inverse upper-shriek unit isomorphism; simplifying the inverse and inclusion maps gives exactly the stated open-immersion normalization.

theorem smoothPurityIso_zero_of_isOpenImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] :
    smoothPurityIso ℓ j 0 =
      (ObjectProperty.ι _).mapIso (boundedConstructibleUpperShriekUnitIso_padicAlgCl ℓ j) ≪≫
        (tateTwistDerivedZeroIso ℓ X.left).symm ≪≫
        ((shiftFunctorZero' _ (2 * ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by simp)).app _).symm :=
  sorry
